title: Low teacher attendance at Mandeville Primary and Winston Jones High on Mar 7
reason: Reported teacher absences/low turnout do not establish a public gathering.
notes: Mandeville Primary: 29% present; Winston Jones: five of 48 reportedly present. These are staff attendance ratios, not protest counts or evidence of sit-ins.

title: JTA delegates’ wage-offer ballot/conference at Mico
reason: Internal union decision-making meeting/ballot is not coded as a public protest gathering.
notes: Delegate voting totals and 1,170 eligible voters are not public protest attendance.

title: Teachers’ work stoppages/sick-outs considered without an accompanying public assembly
reason: A sick-out, go-slow or general absence/service disruption alone does not establish a qualifying public gathering.
notes: Where public sit-ins or marches are evidenced, they are retained as separate school/site candidates.
